entry.title: New: Resolution 236 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS OF A LATER FISCAL YEAR AND OF MORE THAN ONE FISCAL YEAR FOR MULTI-YEAR EMPLOYMENT CONTRACTS FOR THE PLANNING DEPARTMENT

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into four-year contracts for seven positions to deliver recovery efforts from the 2018 Kīlauea Eruption, to be funded with disaster recovery sources.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 236-23 & FC-70- 09/20/23
